title: Applications.
bodyText: Except as provided in section 412:10-410, every application for a loan shall be made in writing upon a form prescribed by the credit union. Each loan shall be evidenced by a written document.
bodyHtml: §412:10-405  Applications.  Except as provided in section 412:10-410, every application for a loan shall be made in writing upon a form prescribed by the credit union.  Each loan shall be evidenced by a written document. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
